review_scope: Post-run independent raw-source replay; no model loaded, training, regrading, or adaptive native follow-up. Source chronology and operations reconstructed directly from raw bytes, without importing the generator or infrastructure solver. Raw-source labels are compared only after independent reconstruction. This review is operational evidence, not a human annotation study.

supported: The instruction bundle changed exposed-development output behavior: old16cap/noEOS/prose became16single-line/EOS/no-cap completions, while task correctness stayed0/16.
A budget-only explanation is inadequate for the residual errors: every response terminates at9–17generatedtokens includingEOS below32.
All8 full-evidence cases still fail; all8 missing-evidence cases also fail. The one grammatical ask requests observedRULE/SYMBOLS in addition to absentSTART.

Register and tool families each produce one repeated completion across their four distinct cases, including answer/ask/unknown targets. This is family-level output repetition, not globalconstant-zero output.
hypotheses_not_proven: The combined UNKNOWN-or-ask wording and field-order placeholder may encourage copying a fallback form and conflating response branches.
The model may fail to bind JSON facts to required fields or select the missing-value policy.
The changed response bundle, increased prompt tokens, and observed dev reuse do not isolate any individual sentence or latent internal mechanism.
not_diagnosed: Muon optimizer behavior: frozen baseline has no optimizer updates.
Hardware/source corruption: current placement, byte checks and guard pass; this probe cannot establish a hidden cause.
General model inability, architecture benefit, retention or broad generalization.

execution.memory_limitations: MPS live/driver and RSS overlap and must not be summed. MPS sampling .25s and host/RSS2s may miss transients; process-lifetime RSS is a high-water mark.

future_proposal_only.version: Separate future v2 protocol required before any execution
future_proposal_only.proposal: Separate the two missing-response policies. Select the appendix using only the public original query instruction and family, never the gold action/response or observed value/missingness. Make available evidence fields distinct from output placeholders and specify one complete response branch. Keep independent source verification and whole-response scoring.
future_proposal_only.not_done: No v2 contract, prompt edits, adaptive follow-up or training occurred within the v1 protocol.

lexical_mention_interpretation: Output field-name mentions are lexical observations, not automatically assertions that each named field is missing. The well-formed FSM ask explicitly requests observed RULE/SYMBOLS; malformed UNKNOWN-plus-list outputs receive no inferred intended answer or task credit.
